subject: zoology
question_text: Write the full form of IUCN. In which book are threatened species listed?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.50, VSAQ 68). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. QUESTION TEXT: the book prints 'In which book threatened species are enlisted.'; the card keeps the same two asks in corrected grammar.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The full form
steps.why: The words of the expansion say what the body does: it is a union of countries and organisations that works on conserving nature.
common_mistakes: Writing 'International Council' or 'Institute'. The first two words are International Union.
Leaving out 'and Natural Resources', which is part of the full name.
steps.memory_tip: I-U-C-N: International Union for Conservation of Nature.
steps.margin_note: One line, written out in full.
lines: IUCN stands for the International Union for
Conservation of Nature and Natural Resources.

steps.label: The Red Data Book
steps.why: The Red Data Book is the record the union publishes, and naming it is the whole of the second mark.
common_mistakes: Writing 'Green Book' or 'Red Book of Animals'. The name is the Red Data Book.
steps.memory_tip: The Red Data Book is named for the colour used to mark danger, and it lists species in danger.
steps.margin_note: Name the book in one line. Nothing more is asked.

lines.text: Threatened species: in the Red Data Book

lines: The IUCN Red Data Book lists the species that
The list is kept up to date and is also called

insider_note: Two one-line answers — the full form and the Red Data Book — so this is a question to finish in under two minutes.
